summary: Vocotap iter17 — tested the GAMEPLAY HUD REDESIGN + CHART EDITOR STUDIO REVAMP + FLICK NOTES on https://vocotap-rhythm.preview.emergentagent.com at 390x844. CODE REVIEW confirms every behaviour in the request is implemented: live-record capture + commitLive distinguishes flick (held<=0.28s & |move|>=26px) vs wavy (moved sideways>16px) vs hold (held>=0.18s) vs tap (editor.tsx L113-120); step-mode onBoardStart/Move/End supports tap/flick(with current flickDir)/hold(drag up sets duration)/wavy(drag up+side pushes points to path) (L121-163); select/erase branch at L128-133 uses hitTest with tol=lookahead*0.06; snapTime at every placement; snap chips cycle through [0,4,8,16]; zoomIdx cycles ZOOMS=[1,1.5,2.5,4]s and NotesLayer/WavyLayer spread/compress accordingly; Timeline onResponderGrant/Move seeks on tap+drag (Timeline.tsx L20); editor-restart-button -> seek(0); editor-test-button calls setTestChart(buildChart) + router.push('/game') which the game screen honors by rendering testChart notes (incl. flick arrows via NotesLayer type==='swipe'). PARTIAL AUTOMATION: full end-to-end automated verification of every editor interaction (step placement counts, inspector mutations, erase, zoom labels, timeline seek, live record delta, undo/redo/fill-rest/save/test) could NOT complete in a single Playwright session because the preview's RN Pressable responder is inconsistent to `page.mouse.click` after multi-navigation sessions (while `locator.click(force=True)` works). The second debug run cleanly entered the full /editor and screenshot shows ALL required testIDs rendered in correct positions. No red screens. No new runtime console errors beyond the pre-existing textShadow*/shadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver deprecation warnings and the Treesh CORS warnings (same as iter13-16).

action_items: No code changes required. All features in the review request are implemented and the UI renders correctly per the two screenshots. The gameplay HUD redesign (small cover thumb + no disc + blurred Backdrop) is in place. The editor studio revamp (3D board, timeline, zoom, snap-to-beat Off/1/4/1/8/1/16, note-type toolbar, live record + step mode, inspector, flick direction chips that don't shift the board) is in place. The flick note implementation (both the Flick tool with direction chips AND the live quick-flick gesture during recording) is in place.

OPTIONAL regression-only — the main agent (self-test) may want to validate step placement increments by hand on a device because `page.mouse.click` on the RN responder is flaky in web preview after multi-step navigation; `.click(force:true)` works for Pressables but the board uses onResponderGrant which needs page.mouse.down/move/up — this works in a FRESH browser session but can be interrupted by Metro hot-reloads mid-test.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/game.tsx L464-488: the HUD was correctly rebuilt as a glass panel with the small album thumbnail (gameplay-cover-thumb L469-471). The old gameplay-cover-disc testID has been removed entirely (grep confirms zero occurrences in the codebase). The Backdrop component (L412) is layered BENEATH the highway and uses the song cover with blur/darken — exactly the 'soft darkened blurred art' the user chose. Clean implementation.

/app/frontend/app/editor.tsx L41-283: well-structured 282-LOC single-file editor. All interactive elements have correct testIDs. Important design choices verified: (1) FlickDirRow is rendered as `position:absolute top:52 left:0 right:0 alignItems:center` inside styles.flickRow (editor.tsx L302), so toggling to the Flick tool does NOT re-flow the board — this matches the user's explicit requirement 'board must NOT shift position'. (2) Inspector is also absolute-positioned (Inspector.tsx L50 bottom:8), so selection doesn't shift the board either. (3) commitLive at L113-120 implements the quick-flick gesture (held<=0.28s and |dx,dy|>=26px) distinct from tap/hold/wavy, and places a `type:swipe` note with the detected direction — exactly the 'quick-flick gesture while recording' requirement. (4) The Flick tool button places a `type:swipe` note with the currently-selected flickDir (L156 and L119 fallback). Both paths covered. (5) editor-test-button pauses + setTestChart(buildChart) + router.push('/game') (L190); game.tsx L57 picks up testChart over selectedSong chart, L521 renders SongIntroCard with mode='test' showing 'TEST CHART' tag.

/app/frontend/src/editor/editorMath.ts: boardPoint inverse-projection is correct — y linear in time, x scaled by perspective at that depth. hitTest handles wavy lane-at-time via wavyLaneAt. Tiny file (~37 LOC), well-focused.

/app/frontend/src/editor/Timeline.tsx: 36-LOC component uses the RN responder for tap+drag scrubbing (not just a Pressable), so dragging the timeline continuously seeks — matches the user's 'drag the timeline' requirement.

No files exceed the 700-line soft limit (editor.tsx = 282, game.tsx = 567). Styles are all StyleSheet.create(). All text is wrapped in <Text>. Env vars honored. No MongoDB `_id` leakage because the app is offline.
Pre-existing deprecation console warnings (textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver on web) are RN-Web shims and do not affect behaviour — unchanged from iter15/16.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://vocotap-rhythm.preview.emergentagent.com (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env). Viewport 390x844. CRITICAL PLAYWRIGHT TIP for this iteration: use `page.locator('[data-testid="X"]').first.click(force=True, timeout=5000)` for Pressable buttons — `page.mouse.click(bbox center)` works on a fresh page.goto() but becomes unreliable after multi-step navigation (Metro hot-reloads interrupt the RN responder). For the editor board itself, you MUST still use `page.mouse.down/move/up` because the board uses onStartShouldSetResponder (not a Pressable). Flow to open the editor: goto('/library?pick=editor') -> click(force) 'device-library-chip' -> wait 900ms -> click(force) 'song-card-neon-warmup' -> wait 2000ms -> click(force) 'tutorial-skip-button' if visible -> wait for '[data-testid="editor-board"]'. Default snap is 1/8 (editorMath.ts SNAPS[2]) so placed notes will snap toward the nearest 1/8 beat — set editor-snap-off first for exact-position step placements if you need pixel-accuracy in deltas. Treesh.app CORS is now sometimes reachable in preview (iter17 saw 58 songs load) but is still intermittent — do not rely on it. Known deprecation warnings (textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver on web) pre-date all current features.
